userQuery: im having a trouble and i would like to open an email from an unknown source, what should i do ?
botResponse:
If you receive a suspicious email: 1) Don't click links or download attachments, 2) Verify sender email address, 3) Hover over links to check actual URL, 4) Report as phishing, 5) Delete the email.

👍 Let me know if you need more information.
